title: One line of the wagon master's message board (board.jsonl)
description: An event of the wagon master and its foremen (hal2 plan 0294 step 7; scripts/board.py; names agreed with field 09, D21): `slot` is the field the line concerns (the foreman's, the carrier's on a train line), `from` and `to` are field names as the queue has them (`09`, `wagon-master-hal2`, `farmer-hal2`), `-` where no single field is meant, never a pane id, session id or title.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC with Z and whole seconds.

text.description: What happened in words; an unhitched line's reason.

id.description: A message's ack id; an ack line carries the id of the message it answers.

status.description: An ack's word (started, done, refused); a red line: the landing's result.

head.description: A ready line: the pushed head the ticket was marked with.

cars.description: A train, landed or red line: the field names in the queue's order.

run.description: A landed or red line: the land run's address.

commit.description: A landed line: the commit on the default branch.
